func run(groups: [[Int]]) async throws {
 for batch in groups {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  let rows = await withTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { await read(item) } }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   return await group.reduce(into: [Int]()) { $0.append($1) }
  }
  consume(rows)
 }
 for batch in groups {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  let rows = try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { try await read(item) } }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   return try await group.reduce(into: [Int]()) { $0.append($1) }
  }
  consume(rows)
 }
 for batch in groups {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
   for item in batch { group.addTask { try await read(item) } }
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   while !group.isEmpty { let row = try await group.next(); consume(row) }
  }
 }
 for batch in groups {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
   for item in batch {
    group.addTask { try await read(item) }
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await group.next()
   }
  }
 }
}
